description: Your agent chats ranked by what needs you: waiting on you first, then finished, failed, CI failing and working, with pinned chats first in each group. Idle chats stay hidden unless you turn them on. Click a chat to open it.

scopes.chat:read: See your agent chats on every machine and what state each one is in.
scopes.chat:write: Mark a chat as read, or pin it, when you click.
scopes.workspace:write: Switch to a chat's workspace when you click it.
